okta_app_integration._comment: Lab 38 (Okta Certified Professional 2.1/2.2). Setting names follow Okta's admin console help for SAML app integrations (Single sign-on URL, Audience URI (SP Entity ID), Name ID format, Application username, Response / Assertion Signature, SAML signing certificates) and provisioning (Enable API integration; To App: Create Users, Update User Attributes, Deactivate Users, Sync Password) as read in 2026. The protocol tie-break (a web app that offers both SAML and OIDC gets SAML) is this course's own choice: both are federation and either is correct in Okta.

protocol_rules.name: SPA, native or mobile app with OIDC

user_status_notes.DEPROVISIONED: Deactivated users lose their app assignments and cannot sign in
user_status_notes.SUSPENDED: Suspended users keep their app assignments but cannot sign in to Okta until unsuspended
user_status_notes.LOCKED_OUT: Locked out users keep their app assignments but cannot sign in to Okta until unlocked

application_username_formats.okta_username_prefix: the part of the Okta username before the @
application_username_formats.email_prefix: the part of the email before the @

concepts.ACS URL: The service provider's Assertion Consumer Service endpoint; Okta calls it the Single sign-on URL and posts the SAML response there.
concepts.Audience URI: The SP entity ID that Okta writes into the assertion's audience restriction so the service provider knows the assertion is meant for it.
concepts.NameID: The subject identifier in a SAML assertion, built from the app's Application username setting and sent in the chosen Name ID format.
concepts.IdP-initiated sign-in: The user starts from the Okta End-User Dashboard tile and Okta sends an unsolicited SAML response to the app.
concepts.SP-initiated sign-in: The user starts at the app, which redirects to Okta with an authentication request and receives the SAML response back.
concepts.SWA: Secure Web Authentication: Okta stores the user's app credentials and fills the app's login form, for apps with no federation support.
concepts.Bookmark app: A dashboard tile that only opens a URL; Okta does no sign-in for it.
concepts.Push provisioning: Okta uses the app's API to create, update and deactivate the app account when the user's assignment or profile changes.
